metadata.name: Iron Compound
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A walled military compound facing a trench line (Style Pack 01: Military Compound). The garrison holds the barracks, command bunker, armoury, two guard towers with mounted guns, a container yard and a motor pool; the raiders stage behind a container, a wrecked car and an armoured truck and come over the top from the trenches. Three ways in: the main gate, a blast door worked from a button with alarm lights; the north gate, open to anyone; and a breach in the west wall, barricaded with planks you can shoot through. Concrete barriers and gabions break under fire; burn barrels light the yard at sunset.
